reasons: ⛔ PARK DISQUALIFIED — the NON-LOO factor systematically beat the leave-one-player-out one (9/11 folds, p=0.035, mean gap -8.42e-06). The park arm's apparent edge here is the player shrinking HIMSELF toward the mean via his own contribution to his park's factor. Park arms are removed from selection for this metric; the non-park rungs are unaffected and still judged on their merits.
